questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'நூலகம்'.
questions.explanation: நூலகம் = நூல் (book) + அகம் (place): library. Laboratory = ஆய்வகம்; museum = அருங்காட்சியகம்.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'அருங்காட்சியகம்'.
questions.explanation: அருங்காட்சியகம் = museum. A zoo is உயிரியல் பூங்கா; an auditorium is அரங்கம்.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'நீதிமன்றம்'.
questions.explanation: நீதிமன்றம் = court of law. Parliament = நாடாளுமன்றம்; prison = சிறைச்சாலை.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'சட்டமன்றம்'.
questions.explanation: சட்டமன்றம் = Legislative Assembly. Secretariat = தலைமைச் செயலகம்; municipality = நகராட்சி.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'வேட்பாளர்'.
questions.explanation: வேட்பாளர் = candidate (one who contests). Voter = வாக்காளர் - a common trap.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'வானிலை'.
questions.explanation: வானிலை = weather (day-to-day conditions). Climate = காலநிலை; rainfall = மழைப்பொழிவு.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'நிலநடுக்கம்'.
questions.explanation: நிலநடுக்கம் = earthquake (நிலம் + நடுக்கம், 'shaking of the land'). Landslide = நிலச்சரிவு.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'வறட்சி'.
questions.explanation: வறட்சி = drought (lack of rain/water). Famine = பஞ்சம்; desert = பாலைவனம்.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'கல்வெட்டு'.
questions.explanation: கல்வெட்டு = inscription engraved on stone. Sculpture = சிற்பம்; painting = ஓவியம்.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'செயற்கைக்கோள்'.
questions.explanation: செயற்கைக்கோள் = artificial satellite (செயற்கை = artificial, கோள் = planet/orb). Rocket = ஏவூர்தி.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'ஒலிபெயர்ப்பு'.
questions.explanation: ஒலிபெயர்ப்பு = writing the sounds of one language in the script of another: transliteration. Translation = மொழிபெயர்ப்பு.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'பழமொழி'.
questions.explanation: பழமொழி = proverb. Riddle = விடுகதை; story = கதை.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'அகராதி'.
questions.explanation: அகராதி = dictionary. Encyclopaedia = கலைக்களஞ்சியம்; grammar = இலக்கணம்.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'சான்றிதழ்'.
questions.explanation: சான்றிதழ் = certificate. Application = விண்ணப்பம்.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'அரசியலமைப்பு'.
questions.explanation: அரசியலமைப்பு (அரசியல் அமைப்புச் சட்டம்) = Constitution. Government = அரசு; election = தேர்தல்.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'மக்கள்தொகைக் கணக்கெடுப்பு'.
questions.explanation: மக்கள்தொகைக் கணக்கெடுப்பு = population count: census.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'வரவு-செலவுத் திட்டம்'.
questions.explanation: வரவு (income) - செலவு (expenditure) திட்டம் (plan) = budget. Audit = தணிக்கை.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'தன்வரலாறு'.
questions.explanation: தன்வரலாறு = one's own life story: autobiography. Biography = வாழ்க்கை வரலாறு; diary = நாட்குறிப்பு.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct English word for 'மாசுபாடு'.
questions.explanation: மாசுபாடு = pollution. Population = மக்கள்தொகை - a look-alike trap.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct Tamil word for 'Honesty'.
questions.explanation: Honesty = நேர்மை. பொறுமை = patience; வலிமை = strength; கருணை = compassion.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct Tamil word for 'Patience'.
questions.explanation: Patience = பொறுமை. கோபம் = anger; சோம்பல் = laziness.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct Tamil word for 'Duty'.
questions.explanation: Duty = கடமை. உரிமை = right; ஊதியம் = wages; விடுமுறை = holiday.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct Tamil word for 'Unity'.
questions.explanation: Unity = ஒற்றுமை. வேற்றுமை = difference/diversity; தனிமை = loneliness; பகைமை = enmity.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct Tamil word for 'Knowledge'.
questions.explanation: Knowledge = அறிவு. அன்பு = love; அழகு = beauty; செல்வம் = wealth.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct Tamil word for 'Freedom'.
questions.explanation: Freedom = விடுதலை. விடுமுறை (holiday) looks similar - a common trap. அடிமைத்தனம் = slavery.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct Tamil word for 'Harvest'.
questions.explanation: Harvest = அறுவடை. விதைப்பு = sowing; உழவு = ploughing; நடவு = transplanting.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct Tamil word for 'Signature'.
questions.explanation: Signature = கையொப்பம். முகவரி = address; முத்திரை = seal/stamp; பெயர்ப்பலகை = name board.

questions.prompt: Choose the English equivalent of the Tamil saying: "ஆழம் தெரியாமல் காலை விடாதே"
options: Slow and steady wins the race
Strike while the iron is hot
questions.explanation: Literally 'Do not put your leg in without knowing the depth' - i.e. think of the risks first: Look before you leap.

questions.prompt: Choose the English equivalent of the Tamil saying: "சிறு துளி பெரு வெள்ளம்"
options: Empty vessels make the most noise
A stitch in time saves nine
All that glitters is not gold
Little drops of water make the mighty ocean
questions.explanation: Literally 'Small drops (make) a great flood': small amounts add up to something big.

questions.prompt: Choose the English equivalent of the Tamil saying: "நிறைகுடம் தளும்பாது"
options: Too many cooks spoil the broth
Empty vessels make the most noise
questions.explanation: Literally 'A full pot does not splash': truly learned people are quiet and humble. The English equivalent says the same thing from the other side.

questions.prompt: Choose the English equivalent of the Tamil saying: "தாயைப் போல பிள்ளை, நூலைப் போல சேலை"
options: Birds of a feather flock together
questions.explanation: Literally 'As the mother, so the child; as the thread, so the saree': children resemble their parents.

questions.prompt: Choose the English equivalent of the Tamil saying: "அளவுக்கு மிஞ்சினால் அமிர்தமும் நஞ்சு"
options: Even nectar turns to poison when taken in excess
questions.explanation: அளவுக்கு மிஞ்சினால் = when it exceeds the limit; அமிர்தமும் = even nectar; நஞ்சு = poison. Too much of anything is harmful.

questions.prompt: Choose the English equivalent of the Tamil saying: "எண்ணித் துணிக கருமம்"
options: Never put off till tomorrow what you can do today
Think well before you undertake a task
questions.explanation: From the Thirukkural: எண்ணி (having thought) துணிக (undertake) கருமம் (the task). Deliberate first, then act.

questions.prompt: Choose the English equivalent of the Tamil saying: "யாதும் ஊரே யாவரும் கேளிர்"
options: Every place is my home town; everyone is my kin
There is no place like home
Every town has its own customs
questions.explanation: Kaniyan Poongundranar's line (Purananuru): யாதும் = every (place), ஊரே = is my town, யாவரும் = all people, கேளிர் = kinsmen.

questions.prompt: Choose the English equivalent of the Tamil saying: "முயற்சி திருவினையாக்கும்"
questions.explanation: From the Thirukkural: முயற்சி (effort) திருவினை (prosperity/wealth) ஆக்கும் (will create).

questions.prompt: Choose the English equivalent of the Tamil saying: "காலம் பொன் போன்றது"
options: Gold is more precious than time
Time is as precious as gold
questions.explanation: காலம் = time; பொன் = gold; போன்றது = is like. Time is precious - do not waste it.

questions.prompt: Choose the English equivalent of the Tamil saying: "ஒன்றுபட்டால் உண்டு வாழ்வே"
options: If we stand united, we can live well
Each one should live for himself
Divided we stand, united we fall
questions.explanation: Bharathiyar's line: ஒன்றுபட்டால் (if we unite) உண்டு (there is) வாழ்வே (life). Compare 'United we stand, divided we fall'.

questions.prompt: Choose the English equivalent of the Tamil saying: "இளமையில் கல்"
options: Old age is the time for learning
questions.explanation: Here கல் is the verb 'learn', not the noun 'stone' - a literal-translation trap. இளமையில் = in youth.

questions.prompt: Choose the English equivalent of the Tamil saying: "கற்க கசடற"
questions.explanation: From the Thirukkural: கற்க (learn) கசடு அற (without flaws/doubts) - learn thoroughly.

questions.prompt: Choose the English equivalent of the Tamil saying: "அகத்தின் அழகு முகத்தில் தெரியும்"
options: The face is the index of the mind
Home is where the heart is
questions.explanation: அகம் here means the mind/heart (not 'home'), முகம் = face: what is in the mind shows on the face. 'Appearances are deceptive' says the opposite.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "நான் நேற்று சென்னைக்குச் சென்றேன்."
options: I will go to Chennai tomorrow.
I am going to Chennai today.
questions.explanation: சென்றேன் = past tense, first person (நான்); நேற்று = yesterday. So: simple past 'I went'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவள் தினமும் காலையில் பாடம் படிக்கிறாள்."
options: She studied her lessons yesterday morning.
She will study her lessons tomorrow morning.
She studies her lessons every morning.
They study their lessons every morning.
questions.explanation: தினமும் (every day) + present tense படிக்கிறாள் = a habit, so the simple present 'studies' is used.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "குழந்தைகள் பூங்காவில் விளையாடிக் கொண்டிருக்கிறார்கள்."
options: The children were playing in the park.
The children will be playing in the park.
The children have played in the park.
The children are playing in the park.
questions.explanation: விளையாடிக் கொண்டிருக்கிறார்கள் = present continuous: 'are playing'. கொண்டிருந்தார்கள் would be 'were playing'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "நாங்கள் அந்தத் திரைப்படத்தை ஏற்கெனவே பார்த்துவிட்டோம்."
options: We have already seen that film.
We will see that film soon.
We are seeing that film now.
We had never seen that film.
questions.explanation: ஏற்கெனவே (already) + பார்த்துவிட்டோம் (completed action) = present perfect 'have already seen'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "நாளை மழை பெய்யும்."
questions.explanation: பெய்யும் is the future form and நாளை = tomorrow: 'It will rain tomorrow'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவன் நிலையத்தை அடைவதற்கு முன்பே ரயில் புறப்பட்டுவிட்டது."
options: The train had left before he reached the station.
The train left after he reached the station.
The train will leave before he reaches the station.
The train has been leaving since he reached the station.
questions.explanation: Of two past actions, the earlier one (the train leaving) takes the past perfect: 'had left before he reached'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "இந்தக் கோவில் ராஜராஜ சோழனால் கட்டப்பட்டது."
options: This temple is being built by Rajaraja Chola.
This temple was built by Rajaraja Chola.
Rajaraja Chola is building this temple.
This temple will be built by Rajaraja Chola.
questions.explanation: கட்டப்பட்டது = passive, past ('was built'); சோழனால் = 'by Chola'. The voice and tense must both be kept.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "திருக்குறள் பல மொழிகளில் மொழிபெயர்க்கப்பட்டுள்ளது."
options: Thirukkural has been translated into many languages.
Thirukkural will be translated into many languages.
questions.explanation: மொழிபெயர்க்கப்பட்டுள்ளது = passive present perfect: 'has been translated'. The book does not do the translating, so the active options are wrong.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "நீ உன் வீட்டுப்பாடத்தை முடித்தாயா?"
questions.explanation: முடித்தாயா = past tense + question marker -ஆ: 'Did you finish?'

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "நான் ஐந்து ஆண்டுகளாக இந்த ஊரில் வசித்து வருகிறேன்."
options: I lived in this town five years ago.
I have been living in this town for five years.
I will live in this town for five years.
I am going to live in this town after five years.
questions.explanation: ஆண்டுகளாக (for ... years) + வசித்து வருகிறேன் (have been living, still continuing) = present perfect continuous.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவர் வந்திருந்தால் நான் அவரைச் சந்தித்திருப்பேன்."
options: If he comes, I will meet him.
If he came, I would meet him.
If he had come, I would have met him.
Since he came, I met him.
questions.explanation: வந்திருந்தால் ... சந்தித்திருப்பேன் describes an unreal past condition: third conditional 'If he had come, I would have met him'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "மழை பெய்தால் நாங்கள் சுற்றுலா செல்ல மாட்டோம்."
options: If it rains, we will not go on the trip.
Though it rained, we went on the trip.
If it rains, we will go on the trip.
As it rained, we did not go on the trip.
questions.explanation: பெய்தால் = 'if it rains' (condition); செல்ல மாட்டோம் = 'will not go'. First conditional.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவள் என்னைவிட உயரமானவள்."
options: She is as tall as me.
She is the tallest of all.
questions.explanation: என்னைவிட = 'than me'; உயரமானவள் = 'she is tall(er)'. Comparative degree.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "தேர்வு முடிவுகள் நாளை வெளியிடப்படும்."
options: The examination results were published yesterday.
The examination results are being published now.
The examination results will publish tomorrow.
The examination results will be published tomorrow.
questions.explanation: வெளியிடப்படும் = passive future: 'will be published'. 'Will publish' wrongly makes the results the doer.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அந்தப் பாலம் இப்போது கட்டப்பட்டு வருகிறது."
options: The bridge was built long ago.
The bridge is being built now.
The bridge will be built next year.
questions.explanation: கட்டப்பட்டு வருகிறது = passive present continuous: 'is being built'. 'Is building' wrongly makes the bridge the builder.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "நான் அவனுக்கு ஒரு புத்தகம் கொடுத்தேன்."
options: I was given a book by him.
I will give him a book.
questions.explanation: நான் (I) ... அவனுக்கு (to him) ... கொடுத்தேன் (gave). Watch the giver and receiver - 'He gave me' reverses them.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "நீ கடினமாக உழைக்க வேண்டும்."
questions.explanation: உழைக்க வேண்டும் = 'must/should work'. வேண்டும் expresses necessity.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவர்கள் இரண்டு மணி நேரமாகக் காத்திருக்கிறார்கள்."
options: They have been waiting for two hours.
They will wait for two hours.
They are waiting at two o'clock.
questions.explanation: மணி நேரமாக = 'for ... hours' (still continuing): present perfect continuous 'have been waiting for two hours'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "சூரியன் கிழக்கில் உதிக்கிறது."
options: The sun rose in the east.
The sun rises in the east.
The sun rises in the west.
The sun has risen in the west.
questions.explanation: A universal truth takes the simple present: 'rises'. கிழக்கு = east (மேற்கு = west).

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவன் நேற்று பள்ளிக்குச் செல்லவில்லை."
options: He does not go to school.
He will not go to school tomorrow.
He did not go to school yesterday.
questions.explanation: செல்லவில்லை = negative; with நேற்று (yesterday) it is past: 'did not go'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவள் பாடிக்கொண்டிருந்தபோது மின்சாரம் தடைப்பட்டது."
options: She sang after the power failed.
The power failed while she was singing.
The power will fail while she is singing.
The power had failed before she began to sing.
questions.explanation: பாடிக்கொண்டிருந்தபோது = 'while she was singing' (past continuous); தடைப்பட்டது = 'failed' (simple past) interrupting it.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "இக்கட்டுரை மாணவர்களால் எழுதப்பட வேண்டும்."
options: The students must have written this essay.
This essay was written by the students.
The students are writing this essay.
This essay must be written by the students.
questions.explanation: எழுதப்பட வேண்டும் = passive + necessity: 'must be written'. 'Must have written' is a guess about the past.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவள் கடிதம் எழுதியிருந்தாள்."
questions.explanation: எழுதியிருந்தாள் = past perfect: 'had written'. (எழுதியிருக்கிறாள் would be 'has written'.)

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவர்கள் நாளை இந்நேரம் பயணம் செய்து கொண்டிருப்பார்கள்."
options: They will be travelling at this time tomorrow.
They were travelling at this time yesterday.
They travel at this time every day.
They had travelled by this time yesterday.
questions.explanation: நாளை இந்நேரம் (at this time tomorrow) + செய்து கொண்டிருப்பார்கள் = future continuous: 'will be travelling'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "எனக்குத் தலை வலிக்கிறது."
questions.explanation: Tamil says 'to me the head aches'; natural English is 'I have a headache' (present).

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "பேருந்து எத்தனை மணிக்கு வரும்?"
options: What time did the bus come?
What time will the bus come?
questions.explanation: எத்தனை மணிக்கு = at what time; வரும் = will come (future). 'How many buses' mistranslates எத்தனை.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "நீ வருவாய் என்று நான் எதிர்பார்க்கவில்லை."
options: You did not expect that I would come.
I expected that you would come.
I did not expect that you would come.
I do not know whether you will come.
questions.explanation: நான் எதிர்பார்க்கவில்லை = I did not expect; நீ வருவாய் என்று = that you would come. In reported speech 'will' shifts to 'would'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவனால் இந்தக் கல்லைத் தூக்க முடியாது."
options: This stone cannot be seen by him.
questions.explanation: அவனால் ... முடியாது = 'he is not able to': 'He cannot lift this stone'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "கதவு திறக்கப்பட்டது."
questions.explanation: திறக்கப்பட்டது = passive, past: 'was opened'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவர் தமிழில் பல நூல்களை எழுதியுள்ளார்."
options: He has written many books in Tamil.
He is writing a book in Tamil.
He will write many books in Tamil.
He has read many books in Tamil.
questions.explanation: எழுதியுள்ளார் = present perfect: 'has written'. பல நூல்களை = many books. 'Read' (படித்துள்ளார்) is a different verb.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "ஒவ்வொரு குடிமகனும் வாக்களிக்க வேண்டும்."
questions.explanation: வாக்களிக்க வேண்டும் = should/must vote (duty). 'Will be voted' is a meaningless passive.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவன் எவ்வளவு வேகமாக ஓடுகிறான்!"
questions.explanation: The exclamation mark makes this an exclamatory sentence: 'How fast he runs!' (no question word order).

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவள் சிரித்துக்கொண்டே பதில் சொன்னாள்."
options: She smiled but did not answer.
She will answer with a smile.
questions.explanation: சிரித்துக்கொண்டே = while smiling; பதில் சொன்னாள் = answered (past). 'She answered with a smile'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "பேசுவதற்கு முன் யோசி."
questions.explanation: பேசுவதற்கு முன் = before speaking; யோசி = think (command). The order of actions must be preserved.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "இந்தியா 1947ஆம் ஆண்டு விடுதலை பெற்றது."
questions.explanation: விடுதலை பெற்றது = got/attained freedom (past tense).

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "நாம் மரங்களை நட வேண்டும்."
questions.explanation: நட வேண்டும் = should plant. நடு = plant; வெட்டு = cut.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "அவன் தன் தவறை ஒப்புக்கொண்டான்."
options: He made the same mistake again.
questions.explanation: ஒப்புக்கொண்டான் = admitted/accepted (past). மறுத்தான் would be 'denied'.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "இந்தச் சாலை நகராட்சியால் சீரமைக்கப்படும்."
options: This road will be repaired by the municipality.
This road was repaired by the municipality.
This road is being repaired by the municipality.
This road will be repaired by the corporation.
questions.explanation: சீரமைக்கப்படும் = passive future 'will be repaired'; நகராட்சி = municipality (மாநகராட்சி = corporation).

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "மாணவர்கள் ஆசிரியரால் பாராட்டப்பட்டனர்."
options: The teacher was praised by the students.
The students were praised by the teacher.
The students will be praised by the teacher.
questions.explanation: மாணவர்கள் (subject) ... ஆசிரியரால் (by the teacher) பாராட்டப்பட்டனர் (were praised): passive, past.

questions.prompt: Translate the following sentence into English: "கடந்த ஆண்டு இங்கே ஒரு பள்ளி கட்டப்பட்டது."
options: A school will be built here next year.
A school was built here last year.
A school is being built here.
A school was closed here last year.
questions.explanation: கடந்த ஆண்டு = last year; கட்டப்பட்டது = was built (passive, past).

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "The doctor examined the patient."
questions.explanation: The doer (மருத்துவர்) and the object (நோயாளியை) must stay the same, and 'examined' is past: பரிசோதித்தார்.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "The meeting will begin at ten o'clock."
questions.explanation: 'Will begin' = future: தொடங்கும். தொடங்கியது is past.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "She is reading a newspaper."
questions.explanation: Present continuous 'is reading' = படித்துக் கொண்டிருக்கிறாள். The last option changes 'she' to 'he' (அவன்).

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "The thief was caught by the police."
questions.explanation: Passive past 'was caught by' = -ஆல் பிடிக்கப்பட்டான். பிடிக்கப்படுவான் is future; the second option reverses the roles.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "We have completed the work."
questions.explanation: Present perfect (completed action) = முடித்துவிட்டோம். முடிப்போம் = will complete.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "Do not touch the electric wire."
questions.explanation: A negative command = தொடாதீர்கள் (do not touch). தொடுங்கள் = touch; தொடலாம் = you may touch.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "He has been ill since Monday."
questions.explanation: 'Since Monday' = திங்கள்கிழமையிலிருந்து, and 'has been ill' (still ill) = உடல்நலமின்றி இருக்கிறான்.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "Can you help me?"
questions.explanation: 'Can you ...?' = முடியுமா; 'you help me' = நீங்கள் எனக்கு உதவ. The second option reverses the helper and the helped.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "The shops are closed on Sundays."
questions.explanation: A regular state ('on Sundays') = ஞாயிற்றுக்கிழமைகளில் ... மூடப்பட்டிருக்கும். 'Last Sunday' changes the meaning to a single past event.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "Ravi is younger than Kumar."
questions.explanation: 'Younger than Kumar' = குமாரைவிட இளையவன். மூத்தவன் = older.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "Unless you work hard, you will not succeed."
options: நீ கடினமாக உழைத்தால் வெற்றி பெற மாட்டாய்.
நீ கடினமாக உழைத்தாலொழிய வெற்றி பெற மாட்டாய்.
questions.explanation: 'Unless' = -ஆலொழிய (except if). The second option says 'if you work hard you will not succeed', the opposite meaning.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius."
questions.explanation: A general truth = கொதிக்கும். உறையும் = freezes.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "Rome was not built in a day."
questions.explanation: Negative passive past = கட்டப்படவில்லை (was not built). The other options drop the negative or change the tense.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "I have been learning Tamil for two years."
options: நான் இரண்டு ஆண்டுகளாகத் தமிழ் கற்று வருகிறேன்.
நான் இரண்டு ஆண்டுகளுக்கு முன் தமிழ் கற்றேன்.
நான் இன்னும் இரண்டு ஆண்டுகள் தமிழ் கற்பேன்.
questions.explanation: Present perfect continuous = ஆண்டுகளாக ... கற்று வருகிறேன். 'Two years ago' (ஆண்டுகளுக்கு முன்) is a simple past trap.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "Let us go to the temple."
questions.explanation: 'Let us' (a suggestion that includes the speaker) = நாம் ... போகலாம். போகட்டும் = 'let them go'.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "The Chief Minister inaugurated the new bridge."
questions.explanation: 'Inaugurated' = திறந்து வைத்தார் (past). வைப்பார் = will inaugurate; the last option is negative.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "The farmers are waiting for the rain."
questions.explanation: 'Are waiting' (present) = காத்திருக்கிறார்கள். காத்திருந்தனர் = were waiting; காத்திருப்பார்கள் = will wait.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "Honesty is the best policy."
questions.explanation: நேர்மை = honesty; சிறந்த = best; கொள்கை = policy/principle. The emphatic -ஏ gives 'is the best'.

questions.prompt: Which of the following Tamil sentences best conveys the meaning of: "The letter was written by him."
questions.explanation: 'By him' = அவனால் (agent); 'to him' = அவனுக்கு is a trap. 'Was written' = எழுதப்பட்டது (past passive).
